thread.title: ‘Hot’ money is flowing into Netflix, Facebook and Amazon again

author: Nigam Arora
title: ‘Hot’ money is flowing into Netflix, Facebook and Amazon again
text:
To understand the direction of the stock market, it’s important to first look at the leaders. The leaders in this market have been popular technology stocks, which have marched upwards primarily because the hot money has been flowing into them. The hot money mostly cares about the momentum.
Money flows provide an edge to investors who want to beat the market and lower their risks. Let’s explore by looking at momo (momentum) crowd money flows with the help of a chart.
Please click here for the annotated chart of money flows in 11 popular technology stocks. As a group, these stocks have outperformed the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.11% S&P 500 SPX, +0.20% and Nasdaq 100 NDX, +0.40% and popular index ETFs such as SPY, +0.18% QQQ, +0.36% and IWM, +0.59% Please observe the following from the chart.
• Among FAANG stocks, momo crowd money flows are positive in Facebook FB, +1.08% Amazon AMZN, +1.66% and Netflix NFLX, +3.87% They are neutral in Apple AAPL, +1.20% and Google GOOG, -0.63% GOOGL, -0.59%
• Among semiconductor stocks, momo crowd money flows are positive in AMD AMD, +2.58% and Nvidia NVDA, +1.20% They are negative in Intel INTC, -2.11%
• Momo crowd money flows are positive in Tesla TSLA, +2.32% as short-sellers are getting squeezed.
• Momo crowd money flows are positive in Alibaba BABA, +0.00% which is the Amazon of China in spite of a bear market in Chinese stocks by some measures.
• Momo crowd money flows are positive in Microsoft MSFT, +0.72%
• There is quite a contrast between the momo crowd flows and smart money flows, as shown on the chart.

What to do now As per the momo crowd money flows, there is no sell signal yet. However, in view of the smart money being mostly neutral, it is important to not be overly aggressive. We provide to The Arora Report subscribers specific cash level and hedges as well as specific positions to buy, hold or sell.
Some of the leading economic indicators are beginning to deteriorate. The story of synchronized global growth is not as strong now as it was only very recently. Risks from a trade war have also increased. There is more risk in the market today than a couple of weeks ago. More risk does not mean selling good positions. For practical purposes, it means holding enough cash.
